title: Spectrum 22: Contemporary Fantastic Art
content: Spectrum 22has just arrived in the mailbox and in the bookstores. Each year, Spectrum gathers together a broad array of imaginative realism—or "contemporary fantastic art"—into a large hardbound book.The artwork includes fantasy, science fiction, comics, paleo-art, concept art, and sculpture. A professional jury selects the work. There's a healthy balance between digital and hand-made artwork. I'm thrilled that a couple of my dinosaur-science paintings are part of this edition.TheCall for Entrieshas just been announced for the next one, Spectrum 23. The deadline is January 25, 2016. Even though the competition is challenging, I recommend entering because the visibility is good, the entry costs are reasonable, and it's good company to be in.The judges for Spectrum 23 will include some of the top imaginative creators in the field, includingDavid Palumbo, Cynthia Sheppard, Kirk Thatcher, Charlie Wen, and Terryl Whitlatch.EVENT NOTICE. There will be a Spectrum 22 book signing in San Francisco on November 13th with over twenty artists at the Academy of Art Universityat 79 New Montgomery in San Francisco, California from 7:00 to 9:00 P.M.------Spectrum 22: The Best in Contemporary Fantastic Art(Amazon link) is hardbound, 9 x 12 inches, 304 pages.Spectrum websiteCall for Entries info
